info.name: Absentify Absences Departments API
info.description:
The Absentify REST API provides comprehensive absence management capabilities for Microsoft 365-integrated organizations. Manage members, departments, leave types, requests, allowances, public holidays, and workspace settings. The API requires the Plus plan and uses API key authentication. Rate limit: 150 requests per second per IP.

Contact Support:
 Email: support@absentify.com
